<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to an SN2 reaction where a C‑N bond is formed in the forward direction and a halide (e.g., Cl) is broken. In retrosynthesis we will break the C‑N bond and re‑introduce a halide. We'll search the template catalog for forward criteria: broken functional group “halide” and formed functional group “C-N”.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
